headline: Frozen protein language models get dynamics, structure and ligand context grafted on
label: Biophysically Conditioned Protein Language Models
summary: New work adapts frozen PLM embeddings with molecular dynamics, 3D structure, geometry and chemical modalities for variant, PTM, kinetics and affinity prediction.
synthesis: The dominant move is to keep a pretrained protein language model frozen or lightly adapted and graft on physical, structural or chemical context. DynamicsPLM attaches residue-level and pairwise molecular dynamics heads to a 35M model for zero-shot variant effects; MutAtlas scores exhaustive PDB-wide single-site mutations with energy, language and inverse-folding models; HieraPTM combines sequence, PLM and 3D features from site recognition to functional phosphosite prediction. On the interaction side, BioLM-Score couples frozen protein and molecular LM embeddings with residue-atom geometric likelihoods, MGCA mixes ESM2 with Morgan fingerprints for dissociation kinetics, HandShake adds LoRA and cross-chain attention to ProstT5 for partner-specific interfaces, STORM predicts affinity structure-free, and a ligand-aware benchmark tests zero-shot residue-level binding sites. Parallel chemistry work (ReMoD-Mol, ontology pre-training) and single-cell perturbation models (S1Pert, OCCAM, graph-guided flow matching) apply the same recipe: frozen encoders plus injected external knowledge.
